text: Lovely dish, lid does not fit well at all, very rocky, does not set well into rim.. Beautiful graphics on the sides, just wish the lid fit properly! I also had a hard time registering it, and haven't done so. Had some troublele navigating the Lenox web site, to do so. Would really like one with a better fitting lid! This one has two spots where it rocks and does not nest in well.
